annotations.title: Inspect your existing agent spending grants

description: Read only the grants belonging to the authenticated agent connection. Connect with Authorization: Bearer ad_agent_<token>; supply no arguments or credentials. The response describes existing scopes, expiry, remaining attempts and available service-credit capacity. It is an advisory, nonreserving snapshot: it cannot create a grant, fund an account, reserve credits, authorize a purchase or raise a limit. Server-side purchase admission remains authoritative. Receipt recovery must keep its original grant and arguments, even if this snapshot changes.
name: inspect_agent_grants
